Skrivli privacy notes
=====================

- No account is required, and there is no cloud sync.
- No telemetry or analytics. Skrivli does not send usage data anywhere.
- Transcription runs on your PC. Audio and text are not uploaded for
  speech-to-text, and there is no automatic upload of recordings or
  transcripts.
- The only network use is downloading a transcription model, and only when
  you ask for it. Skrivli tells you the size first.
- Recordings, transcripts, settings and models are stored on your PC in
  folders you control (see README.txt) and you can delete them at any time.
- Diagnostic logs do not contain audio samples or transcript text.
